abstract: Dual-Reality Maze is a cooperative fantasy game controlled by three Arduino boards. The Explorer uses a joystick to navigate and a photoresistor to reveal hidden paths. The Architect uses a potentiometer and pushbutton to select and operate maze mechanisms, while a servo represents gate movement. A Main Arduino coordinates both controllers through wired I2C and communicates with the laptop game over Wi-Fi. An LCD displays status and time, an RGB LED indicates connection readiness, and a buzzer provides feedback. Original work combines the story, puzzles, game software, communication protocol, and physical controller interactions into one shared experience requiring coordinated teamwork.
